clues: This town is in south Texas, in the United States. It is the main town of its county, Brooks County.
This town stands in dry, arid land. People who try to cross that land on foot can die from exposure and from lack of water.
This town was named for the ranch of its founder, Edward Cunningham Lasater. In 1893 that ranch was one of the largest in all of Texas.
A 2021 film, Missing in Brooks County, told of migrants in this part of Texas. A radio show had shared the same theme back in 2014.
South of this town, on Route 281, stands a Border Patrol checkpoint. It is the biggest source of work in the whole town.
